evidence: REAL GATE IN GATE DIMENSIONS. scoring.toml [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; both gate judge.toml use aggregation="all_pass" with one binary criterion each. test.sh (identical to template) runs gates then score.py, exits on gate failure (lines 213-221) before the scored suite. gates/render/judge.toml:25 hro_gate_render: incorrect password leaves visitor signed out, then seeded Recruiter signs in and sees a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content; 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient.' (auth leg + anti-shell). gates/constraints/judge.toml:25 hro_gate_shared: sign in as Rafael, add a uniquely named candidate to seeded Data Analyst via ordinary UI, reload (still signed in, card present), then in a new independent empty browser context sign in as Observer and find exactly one such card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message or a browser-only save does not satisfy the gate.' gates/constraints/prompt.md:9 specifies the independent context recipe (browser.newContext via browser_run_code_unsafe) and says a reload/second tab is not independent. This is exactly the REVIEW_POLICY 'actual successful operation and independent-context readback' and LESSONS #4 'load, reload, server-backed' shape; it excludes static shells, health-only stubs, localStorage-only apps and no-op saves. IN-DIMENSION GATE IN EVERY SCORED PROMPT. functional/prompt.md:9-13 'Global browser gate and independent scoring': same sign-in/add/reload/independent Observer readback; 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0' -- all 44 functional criteria are binary (0 likert). polish/prompt.md:9-12 same gate; 'gives binary0 throughout' -- all 5 polish criteria binary. visual/prompt.md:9-12 same gate; 'gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero' -- all 5 visual criteria are likert points=5 with anchors 1-5 (judge.toml:18-31 etc.). No scored prompt assigns partial credit on gate failure. NO SAME-ORIGIN. grep -i 'origin' over tests/ finds only 'where the other recruiter put it' in a functional criterion; no prompt, criterion or app_context requires same-origin, local-only assets or forbids CDN; the brief (instruction.md:15, integration.md:12-14) allows browser CDN fonts/scripts. Replays are page.evaluate fetch/context request of observed UI requests, not an origin test. FAIRNESS OF GATE DEMANDS: every gate leg is public -- password Hireops!2026 and account emails (instruction.md:19), roles incl. Observer reads the board (hireops_rules.md:15-20), recruiter adds candidate with name/email/source, new card at bottom of Applied (hireops_rules.md:32-33), seeded Data Analyst job (seed_data.json:93), app_context lists Rafael/Aud. Session surviving a reload is a professional default supported by the brief's own self-check ('sign in ... reload, and make sure nothing breaks', instruction.md:13). Observer substitution allowed ('another working staff account is acceptable'). Scored-gate mutations (one extra Data Analyst card per dimension, unique suffix) do not collide with later protocols: functional Z/K read Platform Engineer and Tomas's seeded Data Analyst conversation/status, not the DA board order. PLAUSIBLE BROKEN APP: a static SPA or localStorage-backed board with mocked 'added' toast fails the independent-context readback in constraints and every scored gate; a server that answers /api/health and serves seed JSON but drops writes fails readback; an app with no auth or that signs anyone in fails render's wrong-password leg. An in-memory server store passes the gate but is caught by hro_restart (scored, correctly outside the gate per LESSONS #4). CONFORMING ALTERNATIVE: an app with drag-only placement or different labels is fine (gate needs only an add-candidate form and a board read; routes/labels not assumed, 'discover by intent'); one using a CDN or a different API origin layout is not penalised. RUNTIME: scripted golden (workspace.cjs:288-314, workspace.json 'gate: a candidate added to a seeded job survives a reload and is read back by the Observer in another context' passed:true; wrong password shows 'do not match' then Rafael signs in) confirms the reference satisfies all gate legs. RESIDUAL RISK (why risk=true, not a defect): (1) raw-evidence-index scope states no full configured judge run exists, so neither gate's judge behaviour nor the scored in-dimension gate zeroing has been measured; (2) feasibility of browser_run_code_unsafe in @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 for the independent context is unmeasured in this task (the prompt offers 'a supported separate-context tool' as an alternative); a tool failure is mapped to binary0 'NOT EXERCISED', which in a gate zeroes the whole reward; (3) the claim that raw Likert 1 'normalizes to zero' in harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 is asserted in visual/prompt.md:12 but not verified here. Minor note (P3, not blocking): the task's gate prompts drop the template's explicit sentence 'External font, script, or CDN asset requests are allowed and are not a failure'; nothing in the task forbids CDN, so it is not a same-origin requirement, but restoring that sentence would remove any judge temptation to penalise off-origin assets.
